issues.description: The circle centre is at O=(-0.020,-0.938), but A(-3.378,-0.374) and B(3.325,-0.377) lie on a horizontal diameter, so the centre must be at y≈-0.375. With the current centre, D (distance 3.91 from O) lies about 0.56 units outside the circle, A and B are at distance 3.4, and C (distance 2.95) lies inside the circle. The O dot is therefore about 37 px below AB, not on it. The C, D, A and B coordinates are already consistent with a centre at y≈-0.375.
issues.suggestion: Change \coordinate (O) at (-0.020,-0.938); to \coordinate (O) at (-0.020,-0.375); keep radius 3.350, A, B, C and D unchanged. The fill dot and O label then move with O.
